data.title: bn-3ak: Bind verifier runtime authority without opening adapters
data.description: Review d9624b9980a8..cb41f04fba1875d651fc0ba7ab4fb433ab58ae55; git diff --binary SHA-256 8b92a6007dd94651b6cccb692d52ae7b96ea3dafd3921e500eb8cb4a2f9150eb. Check operator provenance and authority boundaries, pin and engagement conflicts, path validation, no adapter/process/network effects during resolution, and compatibility with old bindings. Focused tests, strict all-feature Clippy, and serialized offline just check passed.

data.body: [HIGH] Retain the accepted manifest Evidence artifact pin in runtime authority. `ManifestAuthority` carries only revision, digest, and canonical bytes, so this binding cannot supply the immutable manifest `Artifact` required by `PreflightRequest::manifest_artifact` (`preflight.rs:169-176`) and checked before admission (`preflight.rs:425-435`). The bone explicitly requires the accepted canonical manifest and its evidence pin/artifact; omitting the artifact ID either leaves the runtime binding incomplete or forces later wiring to rediscover/fallback outside this operator-owned record. Add the exact typed artifact reference, require its digest to equal the manifest digest during `valid_runtime`/resolution, and cover missing, unknown, and mismatched artifact fields while preserving old Authority defaults.

data.reason: HIGH th-3lh6v2: runtime authority omits the accepted manifest Evidence artifact pin required by preflight; exact target does not satisfy bn-3ak acceptance.

data.body: Fixed in c4d16b71844d587dd40e11b63f9d2e8f62926049: ManifestAuthority now requires the typed Evidence artifact reference and retained metadata. Local validation checks the exact artifact digest against canonical manifest bytes, full artifact/source IDs, kind, size and revision; actual retained metadata still requires the eventual Evidence read. Added missing, malformed, unknown, mismatched, roundtrip and workspace selection coverage. Focused tests, strict all-target/all-feature Clippy and serialized offline just check pass.

Retargeted full review range d9624b9980a89256c460ece23a45b35c3645aabc..c4d16b71844d587dd40e11b63f9d2e8f62926049; git diff --binary SHA-256 9631848176e886a36ac098c31d50973871359eba9a1314ab8246b178e502dea7. The original review description records the earlier target and digest.

Original authority, path, provenance, compatibility, and inert pre-traffic resolution criteria revalidated. Binary patch SHA-256 9631848176e886a36ac098c31d50973871359eba9a1314ab8246b178e502dea7; focused runtime tests, strict workspace all-target/all-feature Clippy, and full just check passed.
